boundaries.evidence: The Definition uses finite quivers and finite sums; for the empty quiver these sums vanish and the representation space is the point.
The Definition allows the zero dimension vector; each GL_0 factor is trivial and the representation space is a point.
The Definition allows dimension-one vertex spaces without imposing a rank restriction.
The Definition permits zero coordinates and block matrices with zero-size blocks.
The zero subobject or zero quotient is included in the exact-sequence correspondence definition.
The Definition fixes standard coordinate spaces and direct-sum decompositions; it makes no global choice of representation bases.
